criticalIssues.description: TypeScript path aliases not resolved in production build
criticalIssues.impact: Service fails to start in production
criticalIssues.rootCause: TypeScript compiles path aliases but Node.js cannot resolve them
criticalIssues.solution: Need to add module-alias or tsconfig-paths/register for runtime resolution
